name: MODEC, Inc.
summary: MODEC, Inc. operates as engineering, procurement, construction and installation (EPCI) general contractor of floating production systems in Brazil, Guyana, Senegal, Cote d' Ivoire, Ghana, Mexico, and internationally. The company builds, leases, and operates floating production storage and offloading, as well as floating storage and offloading; tension leg platforms; production semi-submersible platforms; floating liquefied natural gas floating production facilities. It is also involved in the digital and analytics business; provision of supplier relationship management and supplier registration supply chain services. MODEC, Inc. was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
